gold.gold_rationale: Clause 19 requires a 7-working-day closure SLA backed by a ₹500/calendar-day penalty. The trailing comment '* NOTE: SLA TRACKING TBD' (line 27) is the program's own acknowledgment that the SLA/penalty logic is unimplemented.
